seoTitle: How to Monetize Instagram & Fix Common Setup Issues
metaDescription: Set up Instagram monetization step by step — check eligibility, review policy violations, and fix payment issues blocking your earnings.
intro: Getting Instagram monetization working involves more than just flipping a switch — eligibility requirements, account status, and payment details all play a role. This guide walks through checking your eligibility, resolving policy flags, and setting up payments correctly.

steps.heading: Check monetization eligibility
steps.body: Go to your profile, tap the menu icon, open Creator Tools, and select Set Up Monetization to see if your account meets requirements like minimum followers and no recent violations.

steps.heading: Review policy violations
steps.body: Go to Settings, then Account Status, to check if any content has been flagged, which can temporarily disable monetization until it's appealed or the restriction lifts.

steps.heading: Enable two-factor authentication
steps.body: Turn on Two-Factor Authentication under Settings, Account Center, Password and Security to avoid security-related monetization issues.

steps.heading: Update payment details
steps.body: Go to Settings, then Orders and Payments, then Payment Methods, and make sure your details are accurate to avoid payout delays.

steps.heading: Report ongoing problems
steps.body: If issues persist after checking everything, go to Settings, Help, Report a Problem, and give Instagram full details about the monetization issue.

faq.question: What are the basic requirements for Instagram monetization?
faq.answer: Instagram requires things like a minimum follower count and no recent violations of Community Guidelines, checked through Creator Tools.

faq.question: Why is my monetization disabled even though I qualify?
faq.answer: A flagged piece of content under Account Status can temporarily disable monetization until you appeal it or the restriction is lifted.

faq.question: Does two-factor authentication affect monetization?
faq.answer: Yes, enabling it helps avoid security-related restrictions that can interfere with monetization features.

faq.question: What should I do if payments aren't going through?
faq.answer: Check and update your payment methods under Settings > Orders and Payments, since incorrect details can delay payouts.
